The survey model declares the code lists `stations` and `observers` and the registry `contacts`.
The public example catalogues use those exact lowercase IDs.

## Load the required references

This complete example uses installed files, so it runs without internet access.

```{r}
library(form.references)
model <- form.model::load_form_model(
  "survey", system.file("examples", package = "form.model")
)
cache <- tempfile("survey-cache-")
source <- reference_source(
  system.file("examples", package = "form.references"), cache
)
references <- get_form_code_lists(model, source)
references$data$stations
references$data$observers
registry_source <- reference_source(
  system.file("examples", package = "form.references"), cache,
  catalogue = "registries"
)
registries <- get_form_registries(model, registry_source)
registries$data$contacts$email
```

All CSV columns remain text. Station code `001` keeps its leading zeros.

`references$catalogue` contains versions, source dates, paths and checksums for the selected references.

`references$paths` points to verified local files. `references$publication` identifies the catalogue used.

## Use the website endpoint

The website publishes the same source files under `https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/`.

- [Catalogue CSV](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/codelists.csv)
- [Catalogue metadata YAML](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/codelists.yaml)
- [Stations CSV](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/domain/survey/codelists/stations.csv)
- [Observers CSV](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/domain/survey/codelists/observers.csv)
- [Registry catalogue CSV](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/registries.csv)
- [Registry catalogue YAML](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/registries.yaml)
- [Contacts CSV](https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/domain/survey/registries/contacts.csv)

After website deployment, replace the local source with this URL:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
source <- reference_source(
  "https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/", "cache/survey"
)
references <- get_form_code_lists(model, source)
registry_source <- reference_source(
  "https://ultreia-io.github.io/form.references/examples/", "cache/survey",
  catalogue = "registries"
)
registries <- get_form_registries(model, registry_source)
```

## Reuse the cache

Online calls fetch the YAML metadata first. CSVs are reused when their verified checksums match.

Changed files are downloaded temporarily, checked, then installed in the cache.

Missing HTTP files download concurrently, with four requests at a time by default.
Set `max_connections` in `reference_source()` to change that limit.

A failed download raises an error and leaves previous verified files intact. It never silently returns stale data.

Offline mode makes no source requests and fails if a required cached file is missing or corrupt.

```{r}
cached <- get_form_code_lists(model, source, offline = TRUE)
cached$data$stations$code
```

Concurrent catalogue updates to the same cache are rejected with a busy-cache error.

If a process was killed, remove its `.catalogue-lock` directory only after confirming no process still uses that cache.

## Read references without a model

```{r}
stations <- get_code_lists("stations", source)
stations$data$stations
```

IDs must match exactly; there is no prefix stripping, case conversion or inferred alias mapping.

## Authenticate a private registry source

Supply headers at request time. They are neither printed by the source object nor stored in cached metadata.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
private_source <- reference_source(
  "https://references.example.org/registries/", "cache/private-registries",
  headers = function() c(Authorization = paste("Bearer", Sys.getenv("REFERENCE_TOKEN"))),
  catalogue = "registries"
)
registries <- get_form_registries(model, private_source)
```

Use a distinct cache for each authenticated identity. Authenticated downloads require direct URLs without redirects.

```{r, include=FALSE}
unlink(cache, recursive = TRUE)
```
